## Summary

- make presented retained identity canonical for native primitive mount, focus, accessibility, Automation and cleanup
- move Escape cancellation to the Host/window owner and resolve virtual auto-scroll from accepting destination ancestry
- preserve real callback provenance inside virtual structural scopes and reject stale effect activations at delivery time
- retain per-delivery contract invalidation across sibling failures and bound online schema diagnostics
- unify RangeSlider endpoints, Table local rollback, Rotatable Canvas geometry, marquee tolerance, negative collection dependencies and Tree ancestor indexing
- preserve the third audit and document the final ownership/resource contracts

## Validation

- historical adversarial probes: 48/48 GPUI and 6/6 async
- round-three focused groups: 21/21 native expected-behavior assertions plus 4/4 reviewed runtime core
- workspace all-target/all-feature tests: pass, including 472 core tests
- independent native tests: 133/133
- strict Clippy, rustdoc, structural performance and 69 visual baselines: pass
- crate packaging, release artifact audit and complete macOS release smoke: pass

No crate publish or tag is part of this PR.
title: Fix 0.1.8 interaction runtime round-three findings
